CORE/NAVIGATION-SUBMENU A menu item that opens a list of links; it stands inside core/navigation (or another submenu). Read the core/navigation guide for the whole menu.
MARKUP (comments only, no HTML) <!-- wp:navigation-submenu {"label":"Guides","type":"custom","url":"#","kind":"custom"} --> <!-- wp:navigation-link {"label":"Seeds","type":"page","id":14,"url":"https://example.com/seeds/","kind":"post-type"} /--> <!-- wp:navigation-link {"label":"Tools","url":"https://example.com/tools/","kind":"custom"} /--> <!-- /wp:navigation-submenu --> The submenu itself may point at a page (type/id/url/kind like a navigation-link); a parent with no page of its own uses url "#".
OPTIONS How it opens is set on the parent core/navigation: submenuVisibility "hover" (default), "click" or "always", and showSubmenuIcon. Nesting stops at the navigation's maxNestingLevel (5).
